fact: The GESTARR police-arrondissement management system was generalised across the police arrondissements of Agadir and became operational on 3 August 2019; it links the arrondissements to one another and to the central services of the Sûreté nationale, centralises and follows citizens' complaints, was built by the Sûreté nationale's own technical staff, and continues a project the DGSN had been rolling out city by city over the previous three years.
title: Généralisation du système informatique de gestion des arrondissements de police
